The '''Saffa system''' was located in the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Saffa (species)|Saffa]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="FC" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Saffa [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-8.<ref name="TEA" />
